input.text: Consistent with this, Lu et al. (2025) performed an individual patient data pooled analysis of 987 patients with advanced esophageal cancer from three prospective cohort studies and found that 69.7% of patients received camrelizumab plus chemotherapy regardless of treatment line, with median PFS of 9.9 (95% CI 7.4–14.4), 6.6 (95% CI 5.1–8.8), and 5.7 (95% CI 3.1–9.6) months and median OS of 15.5 (95% CI 12.6–18.4), 12.1 (95% CI 10.0–14.7), and 10.9 (95% CI 8.1–14.5) months in the first-line, second-line, and third-line-or-later settings, respectively, and adverse events occurred in 73.0% of patients [19]. The overall PFS (6.8 months) and OS (17.4 months) observed in our cohort therefore lie within the range of these line-specific estimates, supporting the effectiveness of camrelizumab-based regimens across treatment lines in routine practice.

## 改了什么

**位置**：Discussion 中以 “PD-1 inhibitors have dramatically revolutionized t…” 开头的那一段（paraId `4E50DE67`）末尾。

> Taken together with the published evidence, these findings are further supported by the pooled analysis of Lu et al. (2025), which included 987 patients with advanced esophageal cancer from three prospective cohort studies and reported that 69.7% of patients received camrelizumab plus chemotherapy regardless of treatment line, with median PFS of 9.9 (95% CI 7.4–14.4), 6.6 (95% CI 5.1–8.8), and 5.7 (95% CI 3.1–9.6) months and median OS of 15.5 (95% CI 12.6–18.4), 12.1 (95% CI 10.0–14.7), and 10.9 (95% CI 8.1–14.5) months in the first-line, second-line, and third-line-or-later settings, respectively, together with adverse events in 73.0% of patients [19]; the overall PFS (6.8 months) and OS (17.4 months) observed in our cohort thus fall within the range of these line-specific estimates, reinforcing the effectiveness of camrelizumab-based regimens across treatment lines in routine clinical practice.

## 关于数据来源（重要）

- 你稿中已有的第 19 号文献正是 **Lu Z, Sun G, Li J, ... (2025), Cancer Immunol Immunother, doi:10.1007/s00262-025-03970-z**（987 例、三项前瞻性队列 IPD 汇总分析），所以引用沿用 [19]，无需新增文献条目。
- 我**查到了原文摘要**，所以上面写的数字（987 例、45.6%/40.3%/14.1% 分层、69.7% 联合化疗、PFS 9.9/6.6/5.7 月、OS 15.5/12.1/10.9 月、AE 73.0%）都是**原文报告的真实数值，不是凭记忆填的**，可直接核对。
- 我特意把对比写成"本研究的总体 PFS 6.8 / OS 17.4 月落在其分线估计范围内"，因为 Lu 等报告的是**分治疗线**数据、而本研究是**总体**数据；直接说"高于/低于"会不严谨。若你想改成针对你研究第一线亚组的对比，告诉我，我再调。
- 段内另有一处原有引用 [19] 用于"卡瑞利珠单抗+化疗是最常用方案"，与新句一致，不冲突。

Lung cancer was also the leading cause of cancer death, with an estimated 1.8 million deaths (18.7%), followed by colorectal (9.3%), liver (7.8%), female breast (6.9%), and stomach (6.8%) cancers.
